description: Look up a domain's DKIM public key, trying the selectors Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and common senders use, plus one you name.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. A URL or email address also works.

selector.description: DKIM selector if known (e.g. google, selector1). Common ones are tried automatically.

name: check_dkim
title: DKIM check
